params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$path='C:\HeavenServices\services.json'
$items=@(Get-Content $path -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)
$items=@($items | Where-Object {$_.name -ne 'Heaven Worker Fabric'})
$entry=[pscustomobject]@{
  name='Heaven Worker Fabric'
  category='isolated local workers'
  version='heaven/worker-node22:2026.09'
  install_method='Docker Compose in Ubuntu WSL2'
  executable_container='heaven-worker-01..08'
  URL=''
  host='Docker bridge only'
  port=0
  healthcheck='Docker healthcheck: Node + Python + Git'
  startup_mechanism='base 01-04: Docker restart unless-stopped; burst 05-08: opt-in'
  data_path='Docker named volumes; C:\HeavenServices\worker-fabric\shared; C:\HeavenServices\worker-fabric\artifacts'
  config_path='C:\HeavenServices\worker-fabric\docker-compose.yml'
  update_command='powershell -File C:\HeavenServices\scripts\heaven-workers.ps1 BUILD'
  enabled=$true
  notes='4 healthy base workers at 4 CPU/2 GiB each; 4 verified burst workers at 2 CPU/1 GiB each; no published ports; no host credential mounts'
}
$items += $entry
$json=$items | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($path,$json,(New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($true)))
$check=@(Get-Content $path -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json | Where-Object {$_.name -eq 'Heaven Worker Fabric'})
if($check.Count -ne 1){throw "registry verification failed: $($check.Count)"}
$check | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress
